title: Attention-based Deep Multiple Instance Learning
venue: Proceedings of the 35th International Conference on Machine Learning
population_or_data: Benchmark MIL datasets, an MNIST-derived task, and two histopathology datasets.
task: Predict a bag label from an unordered set of instances.
method: Trainable neural attention pooling constrained to be permutation invariant.
main_findings: The attention operator provides learnable permutation-invariant bag aggregation and per-instance contribution weights.
limitations: The evaluation predates modern WSI foundation encoders and is not specific to cardiac biopsy events.
does_not_establish: High attention weight is not, by itself, validated causal evidence or a calibrated clinical explanation.
relevance_to_project: Mathematical basis for the project's attention pooling baseline and bag semantics.
